description: This file contains SQL schema definitions and related scripts for managing comments on work items within a project in a PostgreSQL database connected to the Supabase platform. It includes table creation, index setup, security policies, functions for comment ID assignment, and triggers for automated ID generation.

methods.name: public.fn_work_item_comment_assign_incremental_id
methods.description: Generates the next incremental comment ID for a given (project_id, item_id) in the work_item_comment table.

calls: select coalesce(max(c.id), 0) + 1 from public.work_item_comment c where c.project_id = NEW.project_id and c.item_id = NEW.item_id
